name: Data.short_forms
summary: q divides out the gains less the allowed losses; the seesaw identity turns lifts of the projected Poincaré series into the chains B_μ, whose size (heightPerRow_le) and local divisibility (exists_indexDvd_Bmu_divisible) give (a) and (b).

steps.claim: Let U = nonsplit(D) ∪ {N_D} and g(l) = ⌊err(l) − [l ∈ nonsplit(D)]·gain(l)⌋ (err = allowedLoss). By `exists_rat_log_eq_and_padic_norm_eq` (U consists of primes: N_D is prime; g vanishes outside U since err(l) = 0 there) there is a rational q > 0 (q0) with log q = ∑_{l∈U} g(l)·log l (e) and |q|_l = |l|_l^(g(l)) for every prime l (v): q divides out the gains, less the allowed losses.
steps.lean:
obtain ⟨q, q0, e, v⟩ := exists_rat_log_eq_and_padic_norm_eq (D.nonsplitPrimes ∪ {D.N})
    (fun l ↦ ⌊D.allowedLoss l - ite (l ∈ D.nonsplitPrimes)
    (D.gain l) 0⌋) (by grind [N_prime]) (by grind [allowedLoss, Int.floor_zero])

steps.claim: From the seesaw identity with its constant c_D (the one in i_N(D)): for every twist ϑ choose a good datum Ψ(ϑ) (G) with ι_ϑ(𝒫_D(c_D·φ)) = B^{Ψ(ϑ)}_μ(φ) for every ramified column φ (S).
steps.lean: choose Ψ G S using D.seesaw.choose_spec

steps.claim: Take q and B := q·P_D (so B = q·P_D by definition); it remains to give (a) and (b).
steps.lean:
refine ⟨q, q0, _, rfl, ⟨_, fun φ k l _ _ ↦ ⟨φ.1.2, k.1 l⟩, D.span_short_ramifiedColumns,
    fun φ k s σ ↦ (map_smul (D.projectedPoincare s) .. ▸ normSqAt_goodProjTranslate_le
    (S .. ▸ weylNormSq_Bmu_le (B := 2 * log q + D.budget)
    (G 1) (by simpa [two_mul, exp_add, exp_log, q0, sq] using k.2 σ ·) ·)).trans (by
    grw [e, heightPerRow_le, Int.floor_le]
    simp [sub_mul, -mem_filter, -union_singleton]
    grw [sum_allowedLoss_mul_log_le]; ring; simpa using D.le_of_hasLogBound)⟩, fun t n y h ↦
    ⟨fun l ↦ #t * finrank ℂ D.Column * (_ * log l),
    fun U ↦ by grw [← mul_sum, sum_allowedLoss_mul_log_le], fun l _ ι ϑ c ↦
    (exists_indexDvd_Bmu_divisible (Int.ceil_lt_add_one _)).elim fun n a ↦ a.2.elim fun _ b ↦
    (IndexDvd.sup (N' := (integralForms ι).comap ((D.Θ ϑ).restrictScalars embValRing)) (f :=
    ((q : ℂ) • D.projectedPoincare · |>.restrictScalars embValRing)) (fun s ↦ b.1.comap
    (D.ramifiedColumns.subtype.restrictScalars _) le_rfl fun φ _ h ↦ congr($((D.Θ ϑ).map_smul ..) ∈
    integralForms ι).mpr (goodProjTranslate_mem_integralForms ι (fun g ↦ by
    erw [weylGauge_smul, congr($(S ..).1 g)]
    simpa [v, weylGauge_smul, ← Int.floor_neg] using (b.2 _ _ (G ϑ) c _ h φ.2).2 g) s)) t _ y
    fun k ↦ subset_span (.inl (Set.image2_subset_left (by exact fun _ ↦ (· l)) (h k)))).imp
    fun u ⟨k, h⟩ ↦ ⟨?_, h⟩⟩⟩
  · apply (Valuation.valuationSubring.integers _).le_of_dvd at k
    simp [norm_p_eq_inv, ← NNReal.coe_le_coe] at k
    grw [← k, ← le_log_iff_exp_le] <;> simp [NeZero.pos]
    linarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right a.1 (mul_nonneg (#t).cast_nonneg (log_natCast_nonneg l))]

    (G 1) (by simpa [two_mul, exp_add, exp_log, q0, sq] using k.2 σ ·) ·)).trans

steps.claim: Let l be a prime, ι an l-adic place and ϑ a twist with l coprime to its level (c). By `Data.exists_indexDvd_Bmu_divisible` with β = ⌈[l nonsplit]·gain(l) − err(l)⌉ = −g(l): there are n′ ≤ err(l)·dim Column(D) (a) and a module S′ of columns with IndexDvd(integral columns, S′, l^(n′)) such that l^(−β)·B^Ψ_μ(φ) is ι-integral for every ramified φ ∈ S′, every twist with level prime to l and every good Ψ (b).
steps.lean:

    (exists_indexDvd_Bmu_divisible (Int.ceil_lt_add_one _)).elim fun n a ↦ a.2.elim fun _ b ↦

steps.claim: For every s ∈ t, q·P_{D,s} pulls the ι-integral lifts back to S′: for a ramified φ ∈ S′, Θ_D(ϑ)(q·P_{D,s}φ) = q·ι_ϑ(|𝖦|e₀s·𝒫_D(c_Dφ)) is ι-integral, because q·ι_ϑ(𝒫_D(c_Dφ)) = q·B^{Ψ(ϑ)}_μ(φ) (S) is (|q|_l = |l|_l^(g(l)) = |l^(−β)|_l by v, and b), and passing to the good part keeps integrality (`Data.goodProjTranslate_mem_integralForms`). This is the hypothesis of `IndexDvd.sup` for the maps q·P_{D,s} over O_ι and N′ = the rows with ι-integral Θ_D(ϑ)-lift.
